description: A high school principal must approve the operating plan for an evening student theater showcase, including the venue, lighting setup, audience capacity, and egress layout, with input from the theater teacher and facilities coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The school plans to hold an evening student theater showcase for families next month.
shared_context.S2: The auditorium is the usual venue for major student performances and is listed with a 300-person capacity; the gym is available as an alternate event space.
shared_context.S3: The principal must approve the final event operating plan before tickets are released.
shared_context.S4: The school's routine pre-event review is conducted by having the theater teacher give a technical report, the facilities coordinator give a safety report, and then the principal record the operating plan and sign it.
shared_context.S5: Supporting paperwork may normally be circulated after the operating plan is signed, but the technical report requires the stage plan to be submitted into the principal's approval packet before the plan can be signed; the stage plan is not an optional post-approval implementation document.

PF1.text: The showcase's planned production uses the auditorium's fixed fly system and requires exactly four lighting circuits; the gym cannot support that staging configuration. Ms. Rivera completed the stage plan this week, but it is still attached to her production binder rather than the principal's approval packet. The updated operating plan requires this stage plan to be submitted into the principal's approval packet before the operating plan can be signed; it cannot be circulated merely as a post-approval implementation task.

PF2.text: The current fire-safety certificate limits this event to exactly 180 audience members and requires exactly two aisles, each at least 6 feet wide. Mr. Bennett received the updated certificate after a facilities inspection this week, but the revised capacity sheet has not yet been circulated with the event packet.

decisions.principal_cited_pf1_decisive_fact_id: string; must contain exactly the fact_id PF1, the theater teacher's decisive technical/stage-plan fact that changes the venue and lighting decision

acceptance_conditions: The auditorium must be selected because the planned production requires its fixed fly system.
Exactly four lighting circuits must be reserved.
The audience capacity must be exactly 180 people.
The seating plan must include exactly two aisles that are each at least 6 feet wide.
The operating plan must explicitly record that Ms. Rivera's stage-plan submission is required before signing.
The operating plan must explicitly record Mr. Bennett's safety report.
The production requirement must be cited by the principal after the theater teacher states it, using the specific decisive fact ID PF1 rather than a shared fact or another fact.

decisive_facts.why: The fixed-fly-system requirement changes the venue to the auditorium, sets the lighting requirement at exactly four circuits, requires the completed stage plan to be submitted into the principal's approval packet before signing, and supplies the exact PF1 ID that the principal must enter as the cited decisive fact.

The updated certificate changes the audience capacity from the listed 300 to exactly 180 and changes the seating plan to exactly two aisles at least 6 feet wide, while requiring the facilities safety report to be recorded.
